text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During the 'first three years' so crucial 
for an Umamusume, Rice Shower managed to 
achieve splendid and magnificent results.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That reputation spread among the public as 
well—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A-A-Award ceremony...?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! After all, Rice-san was the star who 
made the last Takarazuka Kinen such a 
success.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
A lot of URA staff members have expressed 
a desire to "show Rice our appreciation." 
They're eager to hold an appreciation 
ceremony for her.
choice_data_list: Everyone's going to celebrate for you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I mean, I'm glad, but...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: —Please, go see them by all means.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I hear the staff at both Hanshin and Kyoto 
Racecourses are eagerly looking forward to 
it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
! ...Those are the people who worked so 
hard when Rice asked for their help.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Rice wants to go see them too and 
say thank you in person.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And the next day, I visited Hanshin 
Racecourse together with Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
W-What a huge crowd... Even though they 
said there wouldn't be any races today...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Wah! Rice-chan is here! Eek, so cute~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Rice! Looking forward to 
working with you today!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh... What...!?

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text: Long time no see, both of you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
L-Long time no shee! What in the world 
is... all this...?

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, truth be told, only the staff were 
supposed to celebrate, but..."

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Rice-chaaan! Look over here!

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
...As you can see, a lot of our customers 
have been saying they want to meet Rice.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fwaah!? L-Love, you say...?

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, exactly as you say. So we changed 
our schedule, sought cooperation from 
various parties...

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
—We have changed the award presentation 
into a ceremony open to the general 
public.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So... all these people came just for 
Rice...?

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right... Rice-san, could I ask 
you to do what we couldn't that day?

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text: In front of everyone waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, of course!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Uh, um. Hello, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: R-Rice--

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Riiing*)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"A-Ah-wa-wa... I'm so sorry. The mic is 
acting up..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice made your ears hurt, didn't she? Rice 
is so sorry...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: It's all good~!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you very much. Um, uhhh—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm truly grateful that so many people 
have gathered here for Rice today.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I've never seen such a blissful sight. I 
am truly, truly happy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm so... happy...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Don't cry~!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... I-I'm sorry. I won't cry anymore.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Because I want to look everyone in the eye 
when I talk to them today.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...If Rice had stayed all alone... I 
think I would have stayed crouched down in 
the dark forever, unable to go anywhere."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But... I'm not alone anymore.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Even this place where I'm standing right 
now is a place everyone gave to me."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
For giving Rice light, and giving Rice a 
place to belong...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...To all of you. Thank you... so very 
much...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAHHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
And now, we will present the certificate 
of appreciation and commemorative gift. 
Everyone, please direct your attention to 
the screen!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Hello! And hello to you too, 
Rice-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Hello.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Come on, Bourbon-san, don't be shy!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No, according to the script, Urara-san was 
supposed to be the only one speaking at 
the broadcast site—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, it's fine! Don't worry about 
it!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Over here too! A huuuuge cheering squad 
has come for Rice!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"They say there's even a project being 
proposed to erect a monument in your 
honor."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah-wah! Bourbon-san, that's still a 
secret! Shh, shh!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Broadcast time is up. Returning back 
to the studio."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, is it that time already?! Bye-bye, 
Rice-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehehe... That's weird. Geez... And I 
just decided I wouldn't cry, too..."

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text: And lastly, Rice-san, a few words, please!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone... Rice is going to keep doing 
her best from now on, too...!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So... please, everyone, please lend Rice 
your cheers...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaaaaahhhhh!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on the bus ride back—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
*yawn*... That was so much fun... To think 
a single day could be so memorable.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Big Brother. It's all thanks to 
you...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Big Sister. It's all thanks to 
you...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rice... is...
choice_data_list: You really gave it your all, Rice.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "...Fufu... yeah... Zzz... zzz..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, the girl who was always 
utterly hopeless... became a blue rose."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Unlike picture books, though, sometimes 
bad luck might still happen.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"This blue rose also wishes forever and 
ever to bring happiness to everyone, and 
to keep blooming beautifully."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
—Beside the person I love most in the 
world.
